weight_method: fold-training balanced class_weight dictionary times Severe multiplier; 1.0 is a control, not balanced_subsample
weight_retention_requires: Severe F1 strictly improves over RF_T2 and Severe Precision >= 0.45; otherwise retain no optimized weight
combination_rule: apply RF_T2-selected threshold unchanged to the one selected RF weight; never search a weight-threshold grid
no_feasible_rule: do not relax precision floor; retain baseline and mark optimization candidate infeasible
lightgbm_iteration_rule: 291 fixed in every fold; no early stopping or fold-specific hyperparameter selection
interpretation: OOF-selected thresholds and weights are development selection estimates, not independent performance estimates; historical LGBM hyperparameters already saw 2020-2021
